newsitem.title: HONG KONG: CR Beijing Land gives convertible terms.
newsitem.headline: CR Beijing Land gives convertible terms.

text.p: China Resources Beijing Land Ltd announced on Friday the company was issuing US$150 million worth of two percent convertible bonds.
The seven-year bonds due April 30, 2004 carry the right to be converted into the company's ordinary shares at a conversion price of HK$6.30 per share, the announcement said.
The conversion period is April 30, 1997 to April 30, 2004.
The shares were down HK$0.05 at HK$5.35 in late morning trade on Friday.
The bonds bear interest at the rate of two percent per annum, payable each year on April 30. The bonds are redeemable from April 30, 2000 onwards.

The company has also granted to Morgan Stanley & Co International Ltd, the lead manager of the issue, an option to to subscribe for up to US$22.5 million in additional bonds, solely to cover over-allotments, the announcement said.

Assuming full conversion of the bonds, including those that may be issued in the over-allotment and at the original conversion price, the company will issue 212.13 million new shares, representing about 17.04 percent of the existing issued capital and 14.56 percent of the enlarged issued capital of the company.

The net proceeds of the sale of the bonds, which should amount to US$146.3 million or US$168.2 million if the over-allotment option is exercised in full and after expenses, will be advanced to Beijing Huayuan Property Company Ltd, a subsidiary of the company, to finance its future property development and investment activities in China and for general working capital purposes, the statement said.
